prompts.characters: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production character atlas for an original English learning game called Sunlit Village. Make a square 2 by 2 atlas, exactly four equal square cells, invisible grid, each figure centered in its own cell with generous 15 percent padding and no overlap. True transparent background, no checkerboard, no text, no labels, no borders. Original stylized 2.5D hand-painted toy-like game art with clean softly shaded forms, fine dark teal contour accents, sunlight upper left, restrained textures, warm cream, lagoon teal, coral, honey yellow. Each character has tiny legs and a rounded seed-shaped body, expressive small dark eyes and no resemblance to existing game mascots. Top left: Mầm, a cheerful cream seed explorer with two asymmetrical teal leaves sprouting from its head, coral kerchief, teal satchel with a little speech-bubble clasp, waving. Top right: Nắng, a honey-yellow rounded seed librarian with round translucent teal glasses, teal apron, holding an open coral book, a single curled leaf. Bottom left: Mây, a powder-blue rounded seed travel guide with a coral little travel cap, holding a teal folded map and cream tiny suitcase, two small leaf ears. Bottom right: Sỏi, a coral rounded pebble-shaped inventor with teal overalls, cream utility belt, holding a honey pencil taller than their body, no leaves, friendly. All four face three-quarter front, feet on same baseline within each cell. Complete bodies, crisp silhouettes usable at 64px. Avoid logos, known characters, franchise motifs, watermarks, shadows spanning cells. This is a usable sprite atlas, not a concept presentation.
prompts.buildings: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one square production isometric building atlas for an original English learning game Sunlit Village. Exactly 3 columns by 3 rows, 9 equal square cells, invisible grid, each complete building centered within its cell with 12 percent transparent padding, absolutely no overlap or cropping. TRUE transparent background, no checkerboard, no labels, no text, no borders. Premium cozy 2.5D hand-painted toy architectural art, clean sculpted forms, isometric camera showing front and right sides, sunlight upper left, warm cream walls, lagoon teal roofs, coral awnings, honey yellow accents, subtle dark teal contour accents. Signature architecture: roofs like gently curled book pages, rounded speech-bubble windows, mint grass foundation pads. Top row left: training school cottage with open-book roof and honey circular window; middle: travel station with sweeping coral roof, small teal clock tower and blank sign; right: conversation cafe with striped honey and cream awning, two chairs, teal speech-bubble roof ornament. Middle row left: work makers studio with teal sawtooth curled-page roof, honey pencil chimney, large windows; middle: word conservatory, small rounded glass greenhouse with curling teal frames and leaf vines; right: arena circular amphitheater, cream round steps, two coral blank pennants, teal canopy. Bottom row left: IELTS four-story lighthouse tower, four distinct stacked cream floors, coral page-like roofs and golden sun beacon, NOT a famous tower; middle: residential cottage with coral curled roof and teal door and flower box; right: small two-story lagoon teal townhouse, honey rounded roof and balcony. Each building independently useful and similar size. No recognizable branded architecture, no existing game designs, no lettering, no watermark. Soft contact shadow confined inside each cell.
prompts.props: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one square production environment prop atlas for original game Sunlit Village. Exactly 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 equal square cells, invisible grid, TRUE transparent background with no checkerboard, no text, no labels or dividers. Every complete prop centered within its own cell, generous 16 percent empty padding, all same 2.5D isometric angle and upper-left sunlight. Premium cozy hand-painted toy game art with clean softly sculpted forms, fine dark teal contour accents. Palette lagoon teal, leaf mint, cream, honey yellow, coral, no neon. Row 1 left to right: distinctive tree with three curled speech-bubble-shaped mint foliage lobes and honey trunk; squat coral flowering bush with teal leaves; pair of seafoam rounded rocks with one small golden flower; cream planter holding giant teal leaf. Row 2: honey wooden bench with teal legs; short teal lamppost with warm honey globe and curled leaf bracket; coral mailbox with cream speech-bubble mail slot; honey wooden two-way signpost with blank teal and coral signboards. Row 3: cream and coral treasure chest with teal straps and sun-shaped gold clasp CLOSED; same design treasure chest OPEN with softly glowing honey light; cream rolled map tied with coral ribbon and teal compass; teal satchel with cream speech-bubble clasp. Row 4: honey sun-shaped achievement medallion with teal ribbon; stack of three little cream coral teal books; small teal ferry boat with coral canopy and cream hull; honey wooden footbridge with teal railings seen isometrically. All independent objects, no ground landscape joining cells, shadows stay inside own cell. No logos, no franchise items, no watermark.
